svg.aria-label: Field Trek Agency class map: six classes and their 39 fields. Agency holds lists of travelers, guides and treks. Trek links both ways with Traveler and Guide. Equipment and Transport point to Trek, and Trek checks them only during set_dates.
svg.text: 6 classes and 39 fields, showing which fields connect the classes
Field that links to another class
Method call only, Trek stores nothing
Each loan and assignment dictionary holds a Trek object, so a cancelled or moved trek is seen on the next calculation. Trek imports none of the other classes.
